VAR-age.why: HM04 is a continuous numeric member attribute with range 0-99 in the household member roster, consistent with age.

VAR-agecat.why: Age categories can be derived from the continuous age field HM04 in the member roster (inspect during authoring).

VAR-childmth.why: Child age in months can be derived for under-5s from continuous age field HM04 (verify if months are available separately).

VAR-childyr.why: Child age in years for under-5s can be derived from continuous age field HM04.

VAR-male.why: HM03 is a 2-category sex variable with value labels Male/Female in the household member roster.

VAR-marital.why: HM10 has value labels Never married/Married/Widowed/Divorced/Separated (member roster), matching marital status.

VAR-relationcs.why: HM02 has detailed relationship-to-head categories (head/spouse/children/parents/other relative/non-relative etc.).

VAR-relationharm.why: Harmonized relationship-to-head is derived from the country-specific relationship codes in HM02.

notes: Most roster variables in ses54_user_rec02 have empty labels/questions; only HM02/HM03/HM10 expose value labels in scan, so education/disability/language/literacy/school could not be confidently routed from the available metadata.
